description: This file defines an interface and a class related to fault injection in transaction coordination within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for setting multiple grains and adding to grains with optional fault injection, primarily used for testing transaction behaviors.

classes.name: FaultInjectionTransactionCoordinatorGrain
classes.description: Implements transaction coordination with fault injection capabilities for testing purposes.

methods.name: MultiGrainSet
methods.description: Sets a new value across multiple grains.

methods.name: MultiGrainAddAndFaultInjection
methods.description: Adds a specified number to multiple grains with optional fault injection.
